mechanisms.name: difference in diffusion rate between B2 and FCC phases

evidence.quote: The diffusion coefficient of Ni is smaller than the other elements, which leads to the lower diffusion rate of the elements in Ni-rich B2 phase than FCC phase.

At low temperature, due to the sluggish diffusion effect, the diffusion of elements is insufficient, while increased kinetic energy of the elements at elevated temperature leads to the sufficient diffusion of elements.

Since all elements in HEAs can be considered as solid solution elements, the dislocation movement is hindered and the ability of solid solution strengthening is improved, thereby increasing the shear strength of the joint.
